leads.name: Prarthana Bodhiya (Prayer Bodhi), beside the Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi
leads.reason: OpenStreetMap natural=tree node 5174699442, named Prarthana Bodhiya, about 45 m west of the Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi on Sri Maha Bodhi Circular Road. Pin exists (OSM) but no age, no register and no second source found; a tree on the same sacred terrace complex, so access is the same. Needs a dated source or a reader's age before it earns a page.

leads.name: Meditation tree, Kammalakkulama (Trincomalee Road)
leads.reason: [SKIPPED 2026-11-07 by the write pass: OSM name only, unknown species, no source] OpenStreetMap natural=tree node 4702772697 named 'Meditation tree' on the Anuradhapura-Trincomalee Road, about 7 km east of the Sacred City. No species, age or access evidence found; roadside, may be a temple tree. No photo or source in reach.

leads.name: Parivara Bodhi trees on the four lower terraces of the Sri Maha Bodhi enclosure
leads.reason: Wikipedia (Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi) says four lower terraces hold 'Parivara Bodhi' trees that protect the main tree. A group inside the main tree's enclosure, not a separate collectible point; younger, no ages.

leads.name: Thuparamaya Bodhighara and Isurumuniya sapling sites
leads.reason: Sources say excavation exposed the Bodhighara at Thuparamaya where a Sri Maha Bodhi sapling stood, and the Bodhivamsa places a sapling at Issarasamanaramaya (Isurumuniya). These are sites of lost trees, not living trees. No living old tree found at Thuparamaya, Ruwanwelisaya, Abhayagiri, Jetavanaramaya or Mihintale in two searches.

leads.name: Mihintale Ambasthala mango-tree site
leads.reason: Mihintale (about 15 km east of Anuradhapura, roughly 30 minutes by bus or tuk-tuk) marks the spot where the king met Mahinda under a mango tree (247 BC). The shrine commemorates the tree; no living old tree identified. Blocked as a tree, kept as context.
